Opened by payroll-bureau-ie on 2026-11-05

Our payroll provider's export writes amounts under one euro without the zero in
front: `-.75` for a bank fee, `.50` for an adjustment. Every such file fails

args.title: Handle amounts without leading zeros in export
args.body:
File: src/i18n/en.json

Add support for amounts without leading zeros (e.g., `.75` to `0.75`) in the export function to prevent import errors where the amounts are misread as 'not a number'.
